properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 25 at 1:54PM MDT until July 25 at 3:15PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Elk RBX burn scar in...
Central Rio Blanco County in northwestern Colorado...

* Until 315 PM MDT.

* At 154 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Elk RBX Burn Scar. Between 0.2 and 0.6 inches
of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 3 inches
in 1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

Excessive rainfall will result in debris flow moving through the Elk
RBX Burn Scar. The debris flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation
and other loose materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms
producing flash flooding in and around the Elk RBX
Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around
the Elk RBX Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Elk RBX Burn Scar

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 25 at 1:13PM MDT until July 25 at 2:45PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 113 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy
rain across the warned area. Between 0.8 and 1 inch of rain has
fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 0.3 to 0.5 inches in 1 hour.
Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Alpine and St Elmo.
